review: Read complete conversation hook/view, text-owner bridge, test file and unchanged draft store. First-party React/TypeScript with synthetic room/message fixtures; no third-party assets, private transcripts, credentials or runtime state.
Human room text uses only text_list and text_send; neither model nor task submission is implied. AI release controls remain a separate explicit view and dependency.

Read generation, request sequence, room receipt validation and abort checks prevent old history from appearing for another room/account. Safe diagnostic allowlist avoids exposing arbitrary service details.

Room/source/authority/participant identity scopes in-memory drafts; account changes clear them. An uncertain unchanged send retains its client request identity across remounts. Native/server deduplication remains independently enforced.
One text owner stays mounted across dialog changes. Console navigation uses its current admitted member projection; visibility alone grants no room access.
No canonical source changes. Export transformation is CRLF to LF only.
limits: Unfrozen unpublished source proposal, not a standalone client or installed acceptance.
Shared contracts, native/server membership and send handling, and AI release controls remain separate dependencies.
Mocked unit tests do not prove live room delivery, two-profile account isolation, server deduplication, consent or Minecraft/GPT Live continuity.
